_comment: Where the game server is. Published as a release asset so every launcher finds it,
and so moving the server is one edit here rather than telling everyone a new address.
This used to come from an MP_SERVER environment variable, which existed on exactly
one machine - Cam's. Everyone else's launcher checked 127.0.0.1, decided their own PC
was the server, reported it offline, and refused to let them play.
host is a Tailscale address, so it only resolves for people on the tailnet. That is
the point: it is not a public server, and the launcher checks Tailscale is connected
before blaming the server for being down.
name: Night City Online
_coordComment: The assistant coordination API, on the same machine. Anyone with the dev role can
fetch their key from it through the launcher's settings; it is not published
anywhere public, because a key that ships with the installer is a key everyone has.
_tailscaleComment: Invite to Cam's tailnet, so joining is a button rather than a link he has to send
by hand every time. The launcher only shows it to people it has already verified
are in the Discord - see the note in index.html.
